title: Boss Rush: every boss, back to back
description: A new mode next to Free Run and the Daily: the bosses of all four maps in a row with a breather and a level-up between each, its own board label and its own missions.

title: The Liquidity Pool: a fifth map
description: A flooded trading floor with whirlpools that drag you and the bears, a new bear, its own boss and its own music, unlocked in the Market.

title: Story Mode: Chapter 1
description: Five short stages in a row, each with its own goal, a story card between them and a portal at the end that warps you to the next, ending in a boss fight.
